Monitor the TOFU master pipeline (PID 56193, run_tofu_1b_3b_7b.sh). 3 models: 7B, 1B, 3B. 63 total runs.

1. Check alive: `ps -p 56193 -o pid,stat 2>/dev/null`
2. Progress log: `tail -20 /datadrive/forked/open-unlearning/saves/unlearn/_tofu_master_progress.log`
3. Count completed per model:
   - 7B: `ls -d /datadrive/forked/open-unlearning/saves/unlearn/tofu_Llama-2-7b-chat-hf_*/evals/TOFU_SUMMARY.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l`
   - 1B: `ls -d /datadrive/forked/open-unlearning/saves/unlearn/tofu_Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct_*/evals/TOFU_SUMMARY.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l`
   - 3B: `ls -d /datadrive/forked/open-unlearning/saves/unlearn/tofu_Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct_*/evals/TOFU_SUMMARY.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l`
4. For NEW completed runs since last check, read their TOFU_SUMMARY.json, compute HM = hmean(model_utility, forget_quality) using scipy (0 if either is 0), and update docs/results/tofu.md with results. The file has sections: 1B, 3B, 7B each with forget01/05/10 tables.
5. If pipeline crashed (PID dead but not all 63 done), check `tail -30 /tmp/nohup_tofu_master.out` for the error. Fix the issue, then relaunch: `nohup bash /datadrive/forked/open-unlearning/scripts/run_tofu_1b_3b_7b.sh > /tmp/nohup_tofu_master.out 2>&1 &`
6. Give a short status update to the user.
